messages:
Alex: Opening thread — we need to kick off quota + capacity reservation for a new bring-up in asia-southeast2. Target: temporary pool for validation (80x A100-40GB) and initial prod reservation of 320x A100-80GB. Can we get an ETA on quota approval and an ops play for reservation?
Maria: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the exact SKU/quotas you requested? Also need a rough monthly cost estimate so finance can pre-approve spend.
Samir: Quick numbers: 80 * A100-40GB @ estimated $2.6/hr -> ~ $15k/mo for validation if left on 24/7; 320 * A100-80GB @ $3.8/hr -> ~ $340k/mo if fully committed 24/7. We will not run them 24/7 — expected utilization 30-50% in early months.
Alex: SKU mapping for GCP request: "NVIDIA_A100_40GB" and "NVIDIA_A100_80GB" (provider portal names vary). For the formal quota ticket I'm proposing these entries:

```
- region: asia-southeast2
  quotas:
    - metric: "GPUS"
      sku: "A100_40GB"
      requested: 80
    - metric: "GPUS"
      sku: "A100_80GB"
      requested: 320
    - metric: "vCPUs"
      requested: 2048   # for control-plane + k8s nodes
    - metric: "IN_USE_ADDRESSES"
      requested: 40     # LB + nat gateways
```

Samir: FYI we should also request a soft reservation option from the provider (if available) to avoid pub capacity churn during canaries. Tag the ticket with "capacity-reservation" and "priority:high".
Maria: I'm creating a Jira for finance approval now — link once created. Also tagging security for KMS/HSM access in that region.
OpsBot: Ticket INFRA-3321 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-3321 — initial quota + reservation intake. Assigned: Natalie. ETA from cloud provider: 3-7 business days.
Natalie: Taking ownership. Next steps: 1) confirm SKU names with provider rep, 2) open quota request, 3) request capacity reservation or commitment if available, 4) schedule dry-run provisioning in staging. I'll post status updates here.
Leo: For the dry-run, please reserve a small test pool (4 x A100-80GB) and run our autoscaler + KV-cache stress test. I'll validate latency and prefetch behavior.
Alex: Also we need networking: request /24 ephemeral IP pool for egress + a peering connection to prod VPC. Samir, can you estimate NAT throughput req?
Samir: Estimate: for 400 GPUs at 50% util ~ 200 concurrent heavy egress streams; recommend 10 Gbps baseline with burst to 40 Gbps. Add note to ticket.
Natalie: Noted. I'll add the egress / peering request and tag networking.
Maria: Finance approved provisional spend for validation stage up to $25k/month. They'll re-evaluate before full prod commit.
Alex: Cool. Timeline? Natalie, can you aim for quota submission today and follow up with provider rep tomorrow?
Natalie: Submitting now. I'll ping the rep and attach our usage profile and cost note.
OpsBot: INFRA-3321 updated: quota request submitted to provider. Provider ref: PR-74521. Expected provider response window updated to 48-96 hours.
Leo: Once provider confirms quotas, I can start the 4-node dry-run tomorrow afternoon PST. Please leave the provisioned nodes in the "validation" project with audit logging enabled.
Samir: One more ops note — include a fallback model routing plan: if capacity is delayed, route traffic to eu-west3 dedicated pool with autoscaler tweaks. I'll prepare that config and post a snippet.
Alex: Good call. Add a short playbook for handoff: Natalie -> Leo (validation) -> Samir (scale to prod) -> Maria (finance signoff) -> Alex (final go/no-go).
Natalie: Handoff doc created and attached to the ticket. Will post link here once it's live.
Maria: tagging @legal for cross-region data compliance check for asia-southeast2.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Please react with :thumbsup: when your immediate action is done. I'll summarize status in the bring-up calendar entry.
Samir: :thumbsup:
Natalie: :thumbsup: (quota submitted)
Leo: :thumbsup: (dry-run queued)
Maria: :thumbsup: (finance pre-approved)
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled — I'll ping this thread in 48h if no provider response.
Alex: Thread closed for now — will re-open on provider reply."
